item.title: Eni Reactivates 'Supergiant' Venezuelan Oilfield
item.description: Junin-5 restarted operations following the execution of the new license between Eni and Venezuela, under which the heavy oil field is planned to increase production to 200,000 barrels per day by 2028.

item.title: bp posts 304% jump in third-quarter net income to $4.7bn
item.description: bp has reported a 304% year-on-year increase in the Q3 2026 net profit to $4.7bn, driven by stronger refining margins and higher trading performance.

item.title: Equinor Doubles Estimate for Afrodite Gas Discovery
item.description: An appraisal well showed that the Afrodite discovery near the Kvitebjorn field on Norway's side of the North Sea potentially holds 77-180 million barrels of oil equivalent recoverable natural gas and condensate.

item.title: TotalEnergies posts $8.3bn Q3 net income on refining gains
item.description: TotalEnergies more than doubled its net income in the third quarter of 2026 (Q3 2026), posting $8.3bn compared with $3.7bn a year earlier.

item.title: BP Posts Highest Quarterly Profit in 18 Years
item.description: BP said profit surged to the highest in 18 years as soaring refining margins boosted earnings, while a sharp drop in net debt moved the British energy major closer to a position where it could restart buybacks.
